units: GLB local metres. Column-major matrix maps GLB local metres directly to scene centimetres; Matrix4.fromArray(matrix). +X patient left, +Y superior, +Z anterior. Do not mirror twice or independently recenter arches.
boundsConvention: bounds=[local minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ] in metres. cervicalRing is 16 ordered local metre points estimated from native painted CEJ; not measured gingiva.
registrationNote: Right positions independently fit to the corresponding Dundee right reference shapes using reflected left geometry. This is an educational source arrangement, not a clinically validated occlusion.
identificationNote: Published lower central/lateral incisor titles conflict with native LL1/LL2 object labels and geometry. IDs31/41 use the lateral-titled LL1 asset, IDs32/42 use central-titled LL2, independently verified against full-arch source shape.
heroNote: FDI16/26 use the original approved upper-left first molar, optionally reflected by its placement. No Carabelli substitute.
displayClearanceNote: matrix includes a bounded horizontal translation to reduce inherited interproximal overlap. Raw sourceMatrix and the explicit world-cm presentationOffsetCm are both retained for review. The viewer may open whole arches vertically; do not apply presentationOffsetCm a second time.
